search NoSort on items (rows model.Items)
  read      items; root; nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  tenant    items: tenant_id by Scope
  scope     Scope items.tenant_id
  tiebreak  id: the primary key items_pkey (id), by default
search Shapes on items (rows model.Items)
  read      items; root; nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  tenant    items: tenant_id by Scope
  scope     Scope items.tenant_id
  filter    Sku: In, Present on items.sku (text, string)
  filter    Limit: Eq on lowerName()
  filter    Name: Eq on items.name (text, string)
  filter    Name: In on lowerName()
  filter    Stock: Range (min_stock, max_stock) on items.stock (int4, int32)
  filter    Price: Eq on items.price (float8, float64)
  sort      name: items.name, NullsFirst
  sort      active: items.active
  tiebreak  id: the primary key items_pkey (id), by default
search WrongFrom on items (rows model.Items)
  from      itemsOf
  read      items; root; nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  read      tenants; INNER JOIN; ON table.Tenants.ID.EQ(table.Items.TenantID).AND(table.Tenants.Name.EQ(postgres.String(s.TenantID))); one row by tenants_pkey (id)
  tenant    items: tenant_id by Scope
  tenant    tenants: no tenant column; linked to items by items_tenant_id_fkey
  scope     Scope items.tenant_id
  scope     Scope items.sku
  sort      name: items.name
  tiebreak  id: the primary key items_pkey (id), by default
search HandOnly on items (rows model.Items)

  tenant    items: tenant_id by Scope
  scope     Scope items.tenant_id
  sort      popularity: hand-written
  tiebreak  id: the primary key items_pkey (id), by default

search OneConst on items (rows model.Items)
  read      items; root; nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  tenant    items: tenant_id by Scope
  scope     Scope items.tenant_id
  sort      created-at: items.name

  tiebreak  id: the primary key items_pkey (id), by default
search Client on audit_events (rows model.AuditEvents)
  from      eventsOfItems
  read      audit_events; root; nullable item_id, note, client, payload
  read      items; INNER JOIN; ON table.Items.ID.EQ(table.AuditEvents.ItemID); one row by items_pkey (id); nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  tenant    audit_events: no tenant column; linked to items by audit_events_item_id_fkey
  tenant    items: tenant_id by Scope
  scope     Scope items.tenant_id
  scope     Scope audit_events.item_id
  filter    Client: Eq on audit_events.client (inet, string)
  sort      at: audit_events.at
  tiebreak  id: the primary key audit_events_pkey (id), by default
